name: Fortran
description: Fortran compiled ahead-of-time by gfortran (GCC): the original array-oriented numerical language, with column-major arrays, no garbage collector and OpenMP for threads. Its standard library has no hash map, sort or JSON parser, so those programs carry small hand-written versions.

variants.name: gfortran -O3 -fopenmp
variants.description: Optimised build with OpenMP (needed for the parallel workload).
variants.build: mkdir -p {bin}.mod && cp {harness}/lb_hash.f90 {harness}/harness.f90 {bin}.mod/ && cp {src}/main.f90 {bin}.mod/problem.f90 && cd {bin}.mod && gfortran -O3 -fopenmp -o {bin} lb_hash.f90 problem.f90 harness.f90

variants.name: gfortran -O3 -march=native -fopenmp
variants.build: mkdir -p {bin}.mod && cp {harness}/lb_hash.f90 {harness}/harness.f90 {bin}.mod/ && cp {src}/main.f90 {bin}.mod/problem.f90 && cd {bin}.mod && gfortran -O3 -march=native -fopenmp -o {bin} lb_hash.f90 problem.f90 harness.f90
